script_text: Mars in Aries, your fire sign sovereign, ignites a week of sudden reversals as cosmic voltage surges through your 1st House and demands bold reinvention. Monday and Tuesday bring disciplined gains as the Sun trine Saturn stabilizes your 10th House with tangible career traction, yet a harsh Moon square Mars on Wednesday can spark rushed choices and frayed nerves, making early week steadiness essential. The mid-week turning point arrives Thursday when expansive Jupiter trines your Aries Sun and awakens your 5th House, liberating creativity and magnetism after restraint. Late week Venus sextiles Pluto in your 7th House, forging profound intimacy and collaborative leverage while Mars anchors money moves with exacting strategy; weekend clarity seals bold romantic and fiscal commitments. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House to amplify love and artistic charisma. Friday is your worst day as Mercury retrogrades in your 6th House to stall contracts and routines. Set one firm boundary this week to protect your energy and advance work. Follow for daily updates.
